payload.body_you: You respond to {{holder2}}'s feelings with the kind of comfort you also need, and {{holder2}} responds to you in the same way. You and {{holder2}} tend to react to stress and recover from it in the same way. If one of you sinks into a low mood or avoids a difficult feeling, the other can follow, leaving neither of you to steady the moment.
